items.headline: IC address stickers will show your full NRIC number from 1 December
items.summary: From 1 December, anyone who updates their address with ICA will get a sticker showing their full NRIC number instead of a partial one. Existing stickers don't need to be replaced. ICA says the government is moving away from partial NRIC numbers because they can't identify people reliably.

items.headline: Singapore could face 10–20% US tariffs; DPM Gan defends CPF
items.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong said talks with the US could still end in tariffs of 10–20%, with about S$9.4 billion of exports at stake. A US trade report had criticised Singapore's savings policies, including CPF. Mr Gan said he was surprised and that CPF is vital for an ageing society.

items.headline: 13 motorcyclists caught without a licence or insurance at Tuas Checkpoint
items.summary: More than 220 riders were stopped in a joint check on 12 November, and 13 had no valid licence or insurance. Police warned that foreign-registered vehicles can be refused entry if riders don't follow Singapore's rules, worth knowing if you drive or ride across from Johor.

items.headline: Fire at a Little India shophouse; about 25 people evacuated
items.summary: A fire broke out in a shophouse on Chander Road on the morning of 26 November and spread to the unit next door. About 25 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported. SCDF is investigating the cause.
